map.各项取值？: What Values Are Used for Each Item?
map.年龄≥60=1；血压≥140/90=1；临床偏瘫=2（言语=1）；症状≥60mi: Age ≥60 = 1; blood pressure ≥140/90 = 1; clinical hemiplegia = 2 (speech = 1); symptoms ≥60 min = 2 (10~59 min = 1); diabetes = 1.
map.急诊分诊与抗栓/溶栓时机决策。: Emergency triage and the timing of antithrombotic or thrombolytic therapy.
map.根据年龄、血压、临床表现、症状持续时间与糖尿病五项计分TIA后短期卒中风险，总分: Scores the five items — age, blood pressure, clinical presentation, symptom duration and diabetes — to give the short-term stroke risk after a TIA, stratifying warning levels on a 0-7 total, to assist emergency neurology assessment and referral decisions (for reference only).
map.短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）后早期卒中风险分层。: Early stroke risk stratification after a transient ischaemic attack (TIA).
map.：年龄 55(+0)、血压正常(+0)、言语障碍不伴无力(+1)、<10min(: : age 55(+0), normal blood pressure(+0), speech disturbance without weakness(+1), <10 min(+0), no DM(+0): total 1 point (low risk).
map.：年龄 65(+1)、收缩压 150(+1)、单侧无力(+2)、症状≥60min: : age 65(+1), systolic 150(+1), unilateral weakness(+2), symptoms ≥60 min(+2), diabetes(+1): total 7 points (high risk, high stroke risk within 2 days).
